APPROVE

The extracted `foreach`/`try-catch`/nested-`if` block accounts for roughly 9 points of cognitive complexity, which puts `CollectAsync` well under 15. The block moves verbatim with its `#pragma` pair intact and returns the same `locked` dictionary, so behaviour is unchanged. The one thing I couldn't confirm from the diff is that `lockfiles` is declared as `List<string>` to match the new parameter type.
